Direct comparison with approved references

APPROVED MOBILE CONCEPT

Retained: charcoal surfaces, metallic borders, restrained ember highlights, approved character costume and two bottom tabs. Adapted to existing contracts: 48 dp hamburger header, no large brand banner, Today content within the 200 dp budget, sheets cover tabs and retain a fixed Close action. Progress follows the existing app because the ZIP has no Progress concept.

APPROVED CHARACTER CONCEPT

This original remains unchanged. The six new views above are genuine AI reference-image edits of these characters. Facial, pose and seam preservation is shown in the before/after review below; final visual approval remains pending.

APPROVED MUSCLE REFERENCE

Corrected in proposed overlays: the engine uses upper_back and lats separately; it has no standalone traps ID. The reference colour legend is not a tracking schema. Rear-thigh hamstrings, rear calves and glutes have independent regions. No false history or status counts from the concept are copied.

CURRENT APP · LAYOUT CONTRACT

Existing repository test baselines, shown only for layout comparison. Numbers in these historical fixture screenshots are not new tracking data. New previews use unlogged or empty states.
